# ISoundEffects.PitchVariation property

The range the game draws the pitch of each play in, or null for the game's own range, the default. The game varies the pitch of every grapple sound by up to 2.4 semitones up or down. [`None`](../SoundPitchRange/None.md) plays every one at the same pitch.

public SoundPitchRange? PitchVariation { get; set; }
